_doc.purpose: Localization companion for Traits_nsfw.json. Holds en-us entries for the Sadist/Masochist singular traits.

en-us.trait_SexualInterest_tooltip: Positive meaningful interactions with a compatible partner add a little Desire. These gains are not amplified by Lust or attitude and do not determine permission or acceptance.
en-us.trait_SexualInterest_curious_tooltip:
%%trait_SexualInterest_tooltip%%
No Lust threshold; adds 0.3 Desire per interaction.
en-us.trait_SexualInterest_normal_tooltip:
%%trait_SexualInterest_tooltip%%
Requires Lust level 1 or above; adds 0.2 Desire per interaction.
en-us.trait_SexualInterest_conservative_toolti:
%%trait_SexualInterest_tooltip%%
Requires Lust level 2 or above; adds 0.1 Desire per interaction.
en-us.trait_Chastity_tooltip: Importance attached to chastity when granting intimate permissions, separate from sexual interest and action acceptance.
en-us.trait_Chastity_innocent_tooltip:
%%trait_Chastity_tooltip%%
Does not understand intimacy; requires only 25% of the usual permission request scores. Does not modify action acceptance.
en-us.trait_PubicHair_tooltip: How much pubic hair, front and back.
en-us.trait_PubicHair_trimmed_tooltip:
%%trait_PubicHair_tooltip%%
Trimmed pubic hair, shaved at the back.
en-us.trait_PubicHair_natural_tooltip:
%%trait_PubicHair_tooltip%%
Natural pubic hair, some at the back too.
